column1: # Lane ui1 (React component tests of app/test/unit/ui). Cases checking only DOM structure, ARIA attributes, focus or React event wiring have no
# Corvene counterpart to call: Corvene's views are GPUI elements, which need a window (GPUI's test support is not enabled for these tests).

column3: n/a: React DOM/ARIA rendering of AriaLiveContainer (an sr-only aria-live div whose NBSP suffix toggles after a 1 s lodash debounce so Chromium's VoiceOver re-reads it); Corvene's live regions are accesskit Status nodes set by widgets::ListRowA11y::a11y_live on a GPUI element, with no tracked-input re-announcement and nothing to call without a window

omitted: both cases test CommitMessage's Copilot commit-message button (renderCopilotButton / onCopilotButtonClick and the Copilot SDK preview flag); Copilot is left out by design (.docs/TODO.md › Copilot (omitted by design))

omitted: CopilotDisclaimer and GenerateCommitMessageOverrideWarning are Copilot commit-message generation dialogs; Copilot is left out by design (.docs/TODO.md › Copilot (omitted by design), deviation 512-copilot-prompt-omitted)

n/a: React DOM/ARIA and event wiring of the Button, Checkbox, RadioButton, RadioGroup and Select primitives (forwarded refs, CSS classes, aria-* attributes, roving tabindex, checked/indeterminate, event bubbling, change events); Corvene's counterparts (widgets::button / primary_button / button_disabled, checkbox / checkbox_tristate, radio_row, select_button) are GPUI elements whose clicks are GPUI handlers, nothing to call without a window

n/a: React DOM/ARIA rendering of DialogError, DialogSuccess, Caption, InputError and InputWarning (role=alert, CSS classes, the octicon, an aria-live sr-only helper) around their children; Corvene's counterparts (dialog banners, widgets::input_error) are GPUI elements with no logic beyond drawing the given text

n/a: React DOM/ARIA and event wiring of CallToAction, DialogHeader, DefaultDialogFooter and ToggleButton (CSS classes, h1 ids, the spinner octicon, button type/aria-disabled, an uncontrolled checked class toggled by clicks); Corvene's counterparts (widgets::call_to_action, the header of dialog::dialog_loading, DialogButton footers; ToggleButton is used by no GHD view, Corvene's nearest is the stateless widgets::switch) are GPUI elements drawn from their arguments, nothing to call without a window

n/a: DOM focus restoration of a React Dialog that stops and resumes being top-most in a DialogStackContext (document.activeElement, a mocked HTMLDialogElement.showModal); Corvene shows one popup at a time (AppState::popup, Dispatcher::show_popup replaces the previous one, no dialog stack), so a dialog never resumes being top-most, and its focus is GPUI FocusHandles

n/a: React DOM/ARIA rendering of InputDescription variants (classes, role=alert, the octicon, aria-live sr-only helpers) and TextArea (label, rows, refs, onValueChanged unless onChange prevents default); Corvene's counterparts (widgets::input_error, gpui-kit text inputs via widgets::text_box) are GPUI elements, nothing to call without a window

column2: banner surfaces › renders success banner content and triggers dismiss plus undo from the undo link
column3: n/a: React rendering of SuccessBanner around arbitrary children (.success-contents, .green-circle .check-icon) and its Undo click wiring (onDismissed then onUndo); Corvene's Undo link (banner::banner_bar) does the same in a GPUI on_click (Dispatcher::clear_banner then undo_mco), nothing to call without a window

column2: BranchListItem › drops dragged commits onto a non-current branch
column3: n/a: React mouse-event wiring of BranchListItem as a drop target (drop-target class on mouseenter during a dragAndDropManager commit drag, onDropOntoBranch on mouseup); Corvene's branch rows (branch_list.rs BranchFoldout::row) use GPUI drag_over / on_drop (non-current rows only) to start the cherry-pick, nothing to call without a window

column2: BranchListItem › drops dragged commits onto the current branch callback
column3: omitted: onDropOntoCurrentBranch only feeds the dragStartedAndCanceledCount metric (branches-container.tsx onDropOntoCurrentBranch) and Corvene has no usage stats; a drop on the current branch row does nothing in branch_list.rs

column2: component primitives › renders the loading spinner octicon
column3: n/a: DOM rendering of Loading (svg.octicon.spin with aria-hidden); Corvene's icons::loading is a GPUI element with no inputs to check

column2: component primitives › renders a horizontal rule title when provided
column3: n/a: DOM rendering of HorizontalRule (.horizontal-rule-content showing its title prop unchanged); Corvene draws such rules inline in GPUI, there is no logic to call

column2: component primitives › renders footer, ref, and toolbar children with their wrapper classes
column3: n/a: DOM wrapper classes of DialogFooter, Ref (em.ref-component) and Toolbar around their children; Corvene's counterparts (dialog footers, widgets::code_ref, toolbar.rs) are GPUI elements with no logic beyond drawing their children

column2: dialog action wrappers › renders dialog content classes, children, and ref callbacks
column3: n/a: DOM classes and React ref callbacks of DialogContent around its children; Corvene's dialog content (dialog.rs dialog_content) is a GPUI element with no refs

column2: dialog action wrappers › renders a dialog footer wrapper around its children
column3: n/a: DOM wrapper class of DialogFooter around its children; Corvene's dialog footer (dialog.rs) is a GPUI element with no logic beyond drawing its buttons

column2: helper side-effect surfaces › applies theme classes, updates color scheme, and clears theme classes on unmount
column3: n/a: AppTheme's DOM side effects (theme-dark/theme-light body classes, documentElement colorScheme) and its Electron IPC update-window-background-color; Corvene's theme is a GPUI global (theme::init / ActiveGhdTheme) that GPUI windows draw from, with no DOM or IPC
